method.population: Existing L0-L5 archived formal traces, eight fixed questions; descriptive not independent random samples.
method.first_step: Last prompt position, before first generated token.
method.strict_divergence: Actual generated token clean_logit is below maximum clean candidate logit by >1e-06. Top-k union includes clean argmax. Ties are not divergence.
method.clean_shadow: Unsteered entire branch with its own cache, forced to the same generated-token history; not current-step-only needle removal.
method.amplification: Final residual absolute delta / injected-layer residual absolute delta; scale growth can confound mechanism interpretation.
method.dose: Expected direct MLP perturbation norm = abs(dose) * original clean prompt residual calibration scale; +1 is a whole calibration residual scale, not necessarily a small intervention.
method.outcomes: Empty, EOS, limit and repeated token ngrams are mechanical indicators, not automatic semantic failure labels; no p-values.
